caption: The video showcases a white, maze-like track with parallel lanes and a cloud-shaped central bay on a plain white surface, holding many glossy spheres in red, blue, yellow, green and white. A watermark reading AMAKANDU sits in the upper-left corner. The camera gradually pulls back and shifts, so the track shrinks and drifts left while the table opens up on the right. Inside the central bay the dense cluster is not static; individual beads roll against one another, exchanging places and edging toward the bay's right opening. Spheres in the upper and far-left lanes roll along their grooves, moving relative to the track as well as translating across the view. The scattered beads on the open table to the right hold their positions relative to the surface, shifting in frame only as the viewpoint moves. The cluster's arrangement keeps reorganizing, colors sliding past one another rather than settling. No sphere is seen completing a full run, and the motion continues without resolution as the clip ends.
relations: Camera pullback shrinks the track and shifts it left, expanding the visible table area on the right.
Spheres in the central bay roll against one another, exchanging places and edging toward the right opening.
Beads in the upper and left lanes roll along their grooves, moving relative to the track.
Scattered spheres on the right table hold positions relative to the surface, shifting only with the viewpoint.
